faqs.question: What does JEV RNA Detection by Real-time PCR - EDTA Plasma measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of Japanese Encephalitis Virus (JEV) in your blood using a method called Real-Time PCR.

faqs.question: Why is the JEV RNA Detection test done?
faqs.answer: • To detect if you have been infected with the Japanese Encephalitis Virus • To monitor the effectiveness of treatment if you have already been diagnosed with JEV

faqs.question: When is the JEV RNA Detection test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: Your doctor may recommend this test if you have • symptoms such as fever, headache, vomiting, seizures, or confusion, • been exposed to mosquitoes in areas where JEV is common, • travelled to an area where JEV is prevalent, or • already been diagnosed with JEV and require further monitoring of the condition.

faqs.question: What if the results of the JEV RNA Detection test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: If the test results are positive, it indicates that JEV is present in your blood and that you have been infected with the virus.

faqs.question: What to expect during the JEV RNA Detection plasma test?
faqs.answer: A healthcare professional will collect a blood sample from your arm. They will send the sample to the lab for analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the JEV RNA Detection test?
faqs.answer: • You may be asked to fast for a few hours before the test. • Inform your doctor about any medications you are taking and any allergies you have. • Inform your doctor if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the JEV RNA Detection test?
faqs.answer: Serology tests: These tests measure if your body has produced antibodies against JEV.

faqs.question: What is the JEV RNA Detection by Real-time PCR - EDTA Plasma also known as?
faqs.answer: JEV RT PCR or Japanese Encephalitis Virus Real-Time PCR

faqs.question: What is Japanese Encephalitis?
faqs.answer: Japanese encephalitis is a viral infection caused by the Japanese Encephalitis Virus (JEV). The virus is mainly transmitted by mosquitoes and can cause inflammation in the brain and spinal cord. Common symptoms include fever, headache, seizures, vomiting, and confusion. In severe cases, it can be life-threatening.
